caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
action: something colliding with something and both come to a halt
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The car must be moving at high speed before impact.
The front end of the car must visibly crumple upon collision with the wall.
The car must come to a complete stop after the crash.
The impact must cause visible deformation of the wall or surrounding area.
